subject: Life Skills
title: Tone Gets Lost in Text
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Tone Gets Lost in Text.

hook.text: Researchers found people correctly interpret tone in emails only about 56% of the time.

buildup.text: Face to face, you read tone through voice, expression, and body language. Text strips all that away.

discovery.text: Negativity bias makes ambiguous messages feel hostile. 'Fine' reads as angry in almost every context.

twist.text: Adding exclamation marks can help but also backfire. 'Thanks!' feels warm. 'Fine!' feels sarcastic.

climax.text: When tone matters, add a brief clarifier. 'No rush, just checking in!' removes the pressure.

punchline.text: Write how you want to be read, not just heard.

quiz.question: Why is tone often misread in text messages?
options: Text lacks voice, expression, and body language
